title: Earth's mass expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly derive or state that the Earth's mass is M = gR²/G.

title: First cosmic velocity expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly derive or state that the first cosmic velocity is v₁ = √(gR).

title: Satellite altitude expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly derive or state the altitude as h = ∛(gR²T²/(4π²)) - R.

title: Applying Newton's law of gravitation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Newton's law of universal gravitation (F = GMm/r²) to relate gravitational force to centripetal force for the satellite.

title: Relating g to G and M
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use the relation g = GM/R² to eliminate M or find M from the given constants.

title: Centripetal force setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly set the gravitational force equal to the required centripetal force (mv²/r or mω²r) for circular orbit.

title: Orbital radius identification
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify that the satellite's orbital radius is R + h, not R.

title: Confusing orbital radius
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the solution incorrectly uses Earth's radius R as the orbital radius for the satellite in the force equation.

title: Algebraic or sign error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize for algebraic mistakes in solving for h, v₁, or M, or for sign errors in the final altitude expression.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may demonstrate dimensional analysis to verify the consistency of the derived expressions.
